answer: Chain log: each identity starts every answer with the hash of its previous answer, anchored in a basalt checkpoint on the ledger each epoch. Two answers extending the same parent are a fork; anyone submits both as proof and the vault bond of 50 credits is slashed, 30 to the reporter. A farm of 1,000 clones keeps 1,000 separate chains and 1,000 bonds: 50,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, plus a saffron checkpoint fee of 2 per epoch each, 2,000 an epoch. Bypass: a farm that forks only after payout loses the bond unless it exits first. Check rule: anyone replays the chain and counts forks.
